# volcano_function_runtimes (Data Source)

Language runtimes available to functions and durable functions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "volcano_function_runtimes" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `runtimes` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--runtimes))

<a id="nestedatt--runtimes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `runtimes`

Read-Only:

- `default` (Boolean) Whether this is the CLI default for its language.
- `durable_capable` (Boolean) Whether this runtime can back a durable function.
- `label` (String)
- `language` (String)
- `name` (String) Value to use as a function's `runtime`, e.g. nodejs24.x.
